ja: • DD51形ディーゼル機関車のうち、車歴が長く老朽化が進んでいる車両に施された延命工事を、２種の異なる彩色で再現。
• A更新車は青色をベースに白帯、正面がクリームという塗装（実車はのちに赤をベースにした塗装に変更）を再現。
• B更新車は赤色をベースに白帯、灰色で、北海道地区のDF200形ディーゼル機関車に準じた塗装を再現。
en: • The life extension work carried out on the DD51 type diesel locomotives, which have a long history and are aging, is reproduced in two different colors.
• The A updated car has a blue base with white stripes and a cream front (the actual car's paint was later changed to a red base).
• The B updated car is based on red with white stripes and gray, reproducing the paint similar to the DF200 type diesel locomotive in the Hokkaido area.
・Compatible with traveling trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
